articles.title: AbbVie Strikes a $100 Billion Deal With Trump. How the Drugmaker Will Dodge Tariffs.
articles.mainIdea: AbbVie Strikes a $100 Billion Deal With Trump. How the Drugmaker Will Dodge Tariffs.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: AbbVie Strikes a $100 Billion Deal With Trump. How the Drugmaker Will Dodge Tariffs.. AbbVie has agreed to cut some drug prices and invest $100 billion in the U.S. in exchange for an exemption from some tariffs. The pharma company said in a statement late Monday that it had struck a deal with the Trump administration to lower Medicaid prices and pour the money into U.S. research and development. AbbVie will also expand its direct-to-patient offerings of certain drugs on the government portal TrumpRx. Related tickers mentioned: ABBV, JNJ, LLY, PFE.
